distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) confirm Fujian and Hunan in mainland China. Beaver & Liu (2010) separately treated the historical Taiwan record as doubtful. Taiwan is retained as Questionable and is not included in the current reviewed distribution.

host_note: Pinus massoniana and Machilus sp. are supported by 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus aquilus Blandford, 1894.

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus aquilus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus aquilus Blandford, 1894, VSN_6154. 黄复生等 (2015) uses Euwallacea aquilus; historical source names are retained separately.
